import { Component, Input } from '@angular/core';
import { MatIcon } from '@angular/material/icon';

@Component({
  selector: 'ya-label',
  templateUrl: './label.component.html',
  styleUrl: './label.component.css',
  imports: [MatIcon],

export class YaLabel {

  backgroundColor = '#eee';
